sources.binary: El-Badry, Rix & Heintz (2021, MNRAS 506, 2269) list CoRoT-2 and CoRoT-2B in their Gaia EDR3 wide-binary catalogue (VizieR J/MNRAS/506/2269, source_id 4287820848378092672 and 4287820852697823872), 870 AU apart on the sky, with a chance-alignment probability of 2.7e-5: the pair is bound.
